caveat: SWP figures are Bulletin 132-25 Table B-5B deliveries for calendar 2024 (newest actual year in that table). CVP figures are Reclamation Central Valley Operations monthly-delivery tables for 2025 (preliminary, subject to change). Each CVP row is one canal/use table entry; an agency can appear in more than one table. Different projects and years are shown side by side, never ranked against each other.
gaps: Table 22 Delano-Earlimart ID - Out has a blank July cell; printed 96,717 AF total excluded from the complete-year contractor dataset.
SWP table prints Kern County Water Agency as separate Municipal and Industrial / Agricultural columns: 30 rows represent 29 contractors; no summed Kern deliveredAF invented.
CVP entries are separate printed canal/use-type rows; the same agency can appear more than once. Do not sum entries as a whole-project total or treat one row as an agency-wide total.
Contra Costa is present only as a canal diversion in Table 21; not mislabeled as contractor delivery and excluded.
No verified agency service-area/headquarters coordinates: all anchorHint values are null.
CVP publication dates are not printed: publishedDate null rather than guessed from file timestamps.
